description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_지번주소조회 서비스 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 새로운 주소체계의 새우편번호(2015. 8. 1 시행) 및 기존우편번호를 조회하는 기능을 제공하는 지번주소 5자리 우편번호 조회 정보 관련 OPEN API입니다. ㅇ 출력하는 항목(사용자가 응답 받게되는 데이터): 번호, 우편번호, 지번주소. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 경제/경영, 마케팅, 물류/유통관리, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2022-10-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
